name: Smart home hub
summary: Small home-control display on a stand with generic light, thermostat, lock and fan tiles; use for smart home scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the base rests on y; set y to a shelf or table top to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the hub is hero size (about 380 px wide)

params.name: anim
params.note: pulse = the home-control tiles glow in turn
